import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# provisional calibration from current experiments
S_GRID = np.array([0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2], dtype=float)
M_GRID = np.array([5.166666666666667, 5.433333333333334, 6.466666666666667, 8.3, 7.766666666666667], dtype=float)

def interp_mean(speed):
    # linear interpolation inside certified range, linear extrapolation outside
    if speed <= S_GRID[0]:
        slope = (M_GRID[1] - M_GRID[0]) / (S_GRID[1] - S_GRID[0])
        return M_GRID[0] + slope * (speed - S_GRID[0])
    if speed >= S_GRID[-1]:
        slope = (M_GRID[-1] - M_GRID[-2]) / (S_GRID[-1] - S_GRID[-2])
        return M_GRID[-1] + slope * (speed - S_GRID[-1])
    return np.interp(speed, S_GRID, M_GRID)

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    speed = float(regime.config.get("speed", 1.0))
    mean = max(1.0, float(interp_mean(speed)))
    # shifted Poisson to reflect apparent minimum > 0
    lam = max(0.0, mean - 1.0)
    y = 1 + rng.poisson(lam, size=n)
    return pd.DataFrame({"unit_id": np.arange(n, dtype=int), "y": y.astype(int)})

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

KNOTS = np.array([0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.28, 1.36, 1.4], dtype=float)
VALS = np.array([1.4271163556401458, 1.4891517465595985, 1.6541380913520072, 1.9042374526547452, 1.8849028009472895, 2.31377228238461, 2.7194433849316533, 2.990719731730447], dtype=float)

def mean_fn(speed):
    s = float(speed)
    z = np.interp(s, KNOTS, VALS)
    if s < KNOTS[0]:
        slope = (VALS[1]-VALS[0])/(KNOTS[1]-KNOTS[0])
        z = VALS[0] + slope*(s-KNOTS[0])
    elif s > KNOTS[-1]:
        slope = (VALS[-1]-VALS[-2])/(KNOTS[-1]-KNOTS[-2])
        z = VALS[-1] + slope*(s-KNOTS[-1])
    return 1.0 + np.exp(z)

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    speed = float(regime.config.get("speed", 1.0))
    mean = mean_fn(speed)
    # Data are approximately Poisson around a positive floor; shifted Poisson is parsimonious.
    y = 1 + rng.poisson(max(mean - 1.0, 1e-9), size=n)
    return pd.DataFrame({"unit_id": np.arange(n, dtype=int), "y": y.astype(int)})
